description: Renovate is disabled for this repository. It is a 2010 Scala 2.8 reference project: project/build.properties is in sbt 0.7 format (project.organization, build.scala.versions=2.8.0), so no current sbt launcher can build it and no dependency bump can be validated or is worth making.
The packageRules below are kept as a record of why specific updates were rejected, so they still apply if this is ever re-enabled. See closed PRs #2 and #3.

packageRules.description: project/build.properties is in sbt 0.7 format. sbt 0.13+ ignores every key but sbt.version and needs a build definition this repo does not have, so bumping sbt.version cannot yield a working build.
